_doc: Pokémon Emerald NDS overlay of data/sprite_map.json (deep-merged by b2tools/version.py load_json in an Emerald build; emerald_s0 2026-10-12, notes/EMERALD_STORY.md S0-5). Rows for pokeemerald graphics ids Sapphire's file has no row for (Scott, Juan) and the two teams as Emerald draws them. Emerald has both villain teams at once, so there is NO art swap (Ruby's RUBY_SWAPS in b2tools/sprite_upgrade.py): the shared codes keep their Sapphire art, Aqua 293 / 294 / Archie 353 and Magma 302 / 192 / Maxie 303, and pokeemerald places these graphics ids directly in its maps (count = objects in pokeemerald's maps), not through VAR_OBJ_GFX_ID_x as Sapphire does. Wallace 288 and Steven 287 as Sapphire's rows. Not here yet (S0-1, gen_map_content's Emerald mode): pokeemerald's renamed townsperson ids (OBJ_EVENT_GFX_EXPERT_M, POKEFAN_F, NINJA_BOY ...) and its other new ids (Kecleon, Vigoroth movers, dolls, legendaries).

_overworld_extra_doc: Hoenn characters Sapphire draws with another graphics id, given their own Black 2 sheet (b2tools/sprite_upgrade.py): name -> Black 2 object code. Use the code directly (ActorNew / zone NPC model) or through a WKOBJCODE var, as for the Team Aqua/Magma ids.

TABITHA.b2: Black 2 sheet 290 (the female twin of Scott's 289: set only by script file 128, a Unova zone script HoennB2 replaces; no zone entity, PWT record, HoennB2 data or other script uses it), now Tabitha
TABITHA.note: Ruby NDS's own Tabitha sheet (src/sprites/overworld/ruby/088-tabitha: the Magma grunt (M) sheet changed to his battle design) copied as it is to src/sprites/overworld/emerald/290-tabitha (b2tools/sprite_emerald_story.py build tabitha), so Tabitha looks the same in both versions (user decision 2026-10-12). Emerald itself draws him with OBJ_EVENT_GFX_MAGMA_MEMBER_M; 88 stays Matt in Emerald. Used by data/story/ch5.json (Mt. Chimney, model_emerald); the Magma Hideout 4F and Mossdeep Space Center scenes (not built yet) take this code too. Battle picture: src/sprites/trainer/front/emerald/169-tabitha (emerald_data).

_gfx_alias_doc: pokeemerald graphics id -> the pokeruby graphics id of the same person (pokeemerald renamed them; same id number and the same drawing, checked side by side: screenshots/emerald_s0/gfx_alias_candidates.png), so Sapphire's row (its Black 2 code) applies. Read by converter/gen_map_content.py and gen_trainer_npcs.py in Emerald mode. Not aliases (other pictures, need their own rows): VIGOROTH_CARRYING_BOX / _FACING_AWAY (Sapphire's movers are Machoke), ZIGZAGOON_1 (Route 101: Sapphire's Poochyena), the legendaries' story objects (models 4511-4513), the dolls, MYSTERY_GIFT_MAN, TRICK_HOUSE_STATUE, SCIENTIST_2.
_renumbered_doc: (emerald fidelity helper 2026-10-18) pokeemerald renumbered seven townsperson ids that pokeruby also has, so the name alone picks the wrong person: pokeemerald's OBJ_EVENT_GFX_MAN_3 (id 33, the Cool Trainer M) is pokeruby's MAN_4 (id 33), and so on (include/constants/event_objects.h of both; the sprites compared: graphics/object_events/pics/people/, Emerald man_3 = Ruby man_4, man_4 = man_5, man_5 = man_6, woman_2 = woman_3, woman_4 = woman_5; woman_5 = woman_7 retouched). The rows below give each pokeemerald name the code of pokeruby's same person, over Sapphire's row of the name (Emerald builds only). _gfx_alias only covers names pokeruby has not got; these it has, with another person. _gfx_alias's POKEFAN_M -> MAN_3 and POKEFAN_F -> WOMAN_2 point at pokeruby names these rows take over, so those two have rows of their own (Sapphire's MAN_3 / WOMAN_2).
